claims.claim_text: 號稱可 drop-in 取代 HuggingFace 的 tokenizers…但那個「約 1000 倍」得先打個折扣——它自己的 benchmark 就寫明 GigaToken 是整檔不切、做了更多工，對手卻只吃已 presplit 的前 100 MB
claims.evidence: "~1000x faster than HuggingFace's tokenizers, drop-in replacement." … "Gigatoken encodes the whole file un-split, and is thus doing more work than the other tokenizers to find the split boundaries" … "HuggingFace tokenizers (encode_batch_fast) gets the first 100 MB … both presplit"
claims.note: Post frames the ~1000x as claimed (號稱/宣稱) and surfaces the source's own benchmark caveat verbatim; per-machine 989.21x (EPYC), 1353.13x (M4).

claims.claim_text: 用 Ghostty 掃描控制字元當例子，量到約 5 倍。他也直說別太指望編譯器：即使研究了數十年，production compilers 到今天仍常常錯過該向量化的地方
claims.evidence: "more like a 5x speedup" (Ghostty control-character scanning on AVX2); production compilers "regularly miss vectorization opportunities" despite "decades" of research
claims.note: Five-step vectorization paradigm matches source verbatim.

claims.claim_text: 把 Erlang 標準函式庫幾乎補齊——150 個 Erlang function、49 位貢獻者…作者說 Hologram 現在已能用於生產環境，當初 v0.7 上 HN 拿了 107 分
claims.evidence: "150 Erlang functions ported by 49 contributors"; "Hologram is in production today"; version 0.7 achieved "107 points" on Hacker News
claims.note: Elixir-to-JS compiler + client runtime, JS interop, pub/sub, regex, try/rescue/catch all confirmed.

claims.claim_text: 三元權重——每個權重只取 −1／0／+1，平均約 1.71 bits，把部署大小壓到約 7.2 GB，相較 FP16 的約 54 GB 是近 9.4 倍的縮減。model card 宣稱保住了約 95% 的 FP16 智力，平均分 80.49 對上 FP16 的 85.07
claims.evidence: "distilled from Qwen3.6-27B"; ternary weights -1,0,+1; "1.71 bits per weight"; "7.2 GB" vs FP16 "54 GB", "~9.4x"; "retains 95% of FP16 intelligence"; "average score 80.49" vs "85.07"
claims.note: All numeric claims match the model card; post hedges intelligence retention as a model-card claim (宣稱).

claims.claim_text: 在 5,120 個 32 點凸包的壓力測試裡，光是 SSE2 就比 scalar 快了一倍有餘
claims.evidence: "5120 convex hulls, each with 32 points"; "SSE2 is over twice as fast as scalar!" (scalar 40,706ms vs SSE2 17,337ms, AMD 7950x)
claims.note: Edge-edge SAT wide SIMD, SoA requirement, negligible box-box gain all confirmed.

claims.claim_text: Futhark 把加了 records/modules/higher-order/HM 推論/size types 的單遍型別檢查器重寫；舊權宜做法把規則抄兩份；新版拆成四階段；效能慢 20% 優化後快 4%
claims.evidence: "every type checking rule was duplicated in code!"; four-stage: name resolution / ground type inference (unsized) / size inference / in-place update violation checking; "Initial testing showed a 20% slowdown ... reduced this to a 4% speedup"
claims.note: item-06 換題（原 Linux $ORIGIN 已被 2026-07-22 roundup 涵蓋，rebase 後 dedup 命中）；改為 Futhark 型別檢查器重寫，claim 對 futhark-lang.org 來源重抓驗證，四階段、規則抄兩份引語、20%→4% 效能皆逐字相符。

claims.claim_text: 這正是 CWE-88 參數注入，Docker 的 CVE-2019-13139 就是讓 git URL 的片段一路變成 --upload-pack 拿到命令執行…十七個 fork git 的套件管理器裡只有 Go 用了它
claims.evidence: "CWE-88 argument injection"; Docker CVE-2019-13139 injects "--upload-pack=<cmd>"; of "seventeen package managers" forking git, "only one—Go—consistently uses --end-of-options"
claims.note: Dual-marker form git log --end-of-options $rev -- $path also confirmed.

claims.claim_text: PyPI 現在不再讓你往「發行超過 14 天」的版本上傳新檔案…今年三月 LiteLLM 與 Telnyx 被入侵就是導火線…15,000 個專案裡只有 56 個會在發行 14 天後才補上 Python 3.14 的 wheel
claims.evidence: rejects "new files being uploaded to releases that are older than 14 days"; poisoning motivation; March 2026 LiteLLM and Telnyx compromises; "only 56 projects of 15,000 had published a 3.14-compatible wheel more than 14 days after a release"

claims.claim_text: Tokio 團隊發表 Topcoat：一個 batteries-included、走純伺服器渲染的 Rust 全端 reactive web 框架。它刻意繞開 WebAssembly——用一個 macro 把「通過型別檢查的 Rust 子集」cross-compile 成 JavaScript…作者也直言 Topcoat 和偏低階的 Axum 是互補而非取代
claims.evidence: "a modular, batteries-included Rust framework for building full-stack, reactive web apps"; "entirely server-rendered"; "cross-compiles a subset of fully type-checked Rust expressions to JavaScript using a macro … without touching WebAssembly"; Topcoat and Axum "cover very different use cases"

claims.claim_text: 兩萬列以下的 seq scan 幾乎瞬間；在大表建索引一律用 CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY…批次處理可以把吞吐拉高約十倍…一旦某個 autovacuum 跑超過一小時就該調參數，不然可能撞上 transaction id wraparound 停機
claims.evidence: "seq scans on tables with less than 20k rows are pretty much instant"; "always use CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY"; batching "can ~10× your throughput"; "If you see an autovacuum query running for more than ~1 hour, you might want to consider changing your autovacuum settings" with transaction ID wraparound risk
claims.note: Schema-hardest-to-change, short-transactions, pgbouncer advice all confirmed.
